title: Virtual Compute: immediate refund — approved assessment prerequisite
content:
## Prerequisite

Virtual Compute: Before the customer executes an assisted immediate refund, the exact original payment and filed request must have an approved eligible refund assessment with a positive assessed refund amount.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for immediate refund — approved assessment prerequisite?**

The immediate refund action requires this condition to hold for its exact business object.
